blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Carlo Paalam settled for a silver medal in the Asian Games 2026 men’s 55-kilogram boxing as the gold remained elusive for the Philippines in the sport. Paalam lost to Japanese Rui Yamaguchi by split decision, 3-2, in the final on Friday at Nishio Gymnasium to deliver the Philippine boxing team’s only medal in Aichi-Nagoya. The home bet got 29-28 scores from three judges, while the other two favored Paalam, 30-27 and 29-28. The 28-year-old Paalam still surpassed his bronze medal in the 2018 Asian Games and […]...
